_meta.description: Canonical error codes for Yene Verify. Source of truth: backend/src/common/constants/error-codes.ts. Do not add codes here without adding them there first.

AUTH.AUTH_PHONE_INVALID: Phone number is not a valid Ethiopian number (+251 format).
AUTH.AUTH_OTP_EXPIRED: The OTP has expired. Please request a new one.
AUTH.AUTH_OTP_MAX_ATTEMPTS: Too many incorrect OTP attempts. Please wait before trying again.
AUTH.AUTH_OTP_RATE_LIMITED: Too many OTP requests. Please wait before requesting again.
AUTH.AUTH_TOKEN_INVALID: Access token is invalid or expired.
AUTH.AUTH_TOKEN_EXPIRED: Access token has expired. Please refresh.
AUTH.AUTH_REFRESH_INVALID: Refresh token is invalid or has been revoked.
AUTH.AUTH_REFRESH_EXPIRED: Refresh token has expired. Please log in again.
AUTH.AUTH_PIN_ALREADY_SET: PIN is already set. Use change PIN instead.
AUTH.AUTH_PIN_NOT_SET: PIN has not been set for this account.
AUTH.AUTH_PIN_LOCKED: Too many incorrect PIN attempts. Please wait before trying again.
AUTH.AUTH_TOKEN_TOO_OLD: Access token is too old. Please provide a fresh OTP.
AUTH.AUTH_DEVICE_NOT_FOUND: Device not found or already revoked.
AUTH.AUTH_DEVICE_LIMIT_REACHED: Maximum number of trusted devices reached (3). Please remove an existing device.
AUTH.AUTH_SESSION_EXPIRED: Session has expired. Please log in again.

VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_QUEUE_FAILURE: A queue error occurred on our side. Please retry the verification.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_NOT_PENDING: This verification has already been processed.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_NOT_RETRYABLE: Only failed or under-review verifications can be retried.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_NOT_REVIEWABLE: This verification cannot be flagged for manual review.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_MANUAL_REVIEW: This verification is flagged for manual review by our team.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_RECEIPT_MISSING: The receipt for this verification no longer exists.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_DUPLICATE: This receipt has already been verified.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_FAKE: Receipt could not be verified against bank records.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_BANK_UNREACHABLE: Could not reach the bank's verification endpoint. Please try again.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_OCR_FAILED: Could not extract text from the receipt image. Please upload a clearer photo.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_BANK_NOT_DETECTED: Could not identify the bank from the receipt. Supported banks: CBE, Telebirr, Awash, Dashen, Abyssinia, M-Pesa, Zemen.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_REFERENCE_NOT_FOUND: Transaction reference not found in bank records.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Receipt amount does not match bank records.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_NO_CREDITS: No verification credits remaining. Please renew your package.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_UPLOAD_URL_EXPIRED: The upload URL has expired. Please request a new one.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_IMAGE_TOO_LARGE: Receipt image is too large. Maximum size is 10MB.
VERIFICATION.VERIFICATION_IMAGE_INVALID_FORMAT: Invalid image format. Please upload a JPEG image.

BILLING.BILLING_PAYMENT_NOT_VERIFIED: Payment receipt could not be verified.
BILLING.BILLING_AMOUNT_MISMATCH: Payment amount does not match the selected package price.
BILLING.BILLING_RECEIPT_ALREADY_USED: This payment receipt has already been used for a subscription.
BILLING.BILLING_SUBSCRIPTION_ACTIVE: You already have an active subscription for this package.
BILLING.BILLING_MANUAL_REVIEW_REQUIRED: Your payment is under manual review. You will be notified once approved.

CREDITS.CREDITS_LEDGER_ERROR: An error occurred while processing credits. No charges were made.
CREDITS.CREDITS_SUBSCRIPTION_EXPIRED: Your subscription has expired. Renew to continue verifying receipts.
CREDITS.CREDITS_RECONCILIATION_FAILED: Could not reconcile the credit balance. Please try again.

MERCHANT.MERCHANT_SUSPENDED: This merchant account has been suspended.
MERCHANT.MERCHANT_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE: Please complete your merchant profile before proceeding.

SUB_MERCHANT.SUB_MERCHANT_ALREADY_EXISTS: A team member with this phone number already exists.
SUB_MERCHANT.SUB_MERCHANT_LIMIT_REACHED: Maximum number of team members reached for your plan.
SUB_MERCHANT.SUB_MERCHANT_PERMISSION_DENIED: You do not have permission to manage team members.

ONBOARDING.ONBOARDING_REQUIRED: Onboarding required to access this resource.
ONBOARDING.SUB_MERCHANT_EXISTS: A team member with this phone number already exists.
ONBOARDING.AUTH_INVITE_EXPIRED: The invite token has expired. Please request a new invite.
ONBOARDING.AUTH_INVITE_CONSUMED: This invite has already been used.
ONBOARDING.PLAN_LIMIT_SUB_MERCHANTS: Your current plan does not allow more team members.

ANALYTICS.ANALYTICS_INSUFFICIENT_DATA: Not enough verified transactions to generate insights.
ANALYTICS.ANALYTICS_PERMISSION_DENIED: Analytics are only available to merchants, not team members.

EXPORT.EXPORT_NO_DATA: No data available for the selected period.
EXPORT.EXPORT_GENERATING: Report is being generated. You will be notified when it is ready.
EXPORT.EXPORT_FAILED: Report generation failed. Please try again.
EXPORT.EXPORT_TOO_LARGE: The export would contain too many rows. Narrow the date range or use CSV.
EXPORT.EXPORT_NOT_FOUND: The requested export was not found.

GENERAL.VALIDATION_ERROR: One or more fields failed validation.
GENERAL.NOT_FOUND: The requested resource was not found.
GENERAL.FORBIDDEN: You do not have permission to perform this action.
GENERAL.RATE_LIMITED: Too many requests. Please slow down.
GENERAL.INTERNAL_ERROR: An unexpected error occurred. Our team has been notified.
GENERAL.SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE: The service is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
GENERAL.TENANT_ISOLATION_VIOLATION: Access denied. You can only access your own data.
